in_greek.name: Kaylil

in_latin.name: Kaylil
in_latin.long_meaning: Kaylil est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name 'Kaion', meaning 'rejoicing'. In Greek mythology, Kaion was a god of joy and happiness.
